title: South Vancouver Island old-growth forest camps
location: Fairy Creek / Gordon River / Walbran, southwest Vancouver Island, British Columbia
notes: The opened January 22 Wilderness Committee account says camps started in early August 2020 and describes about half a dozen camps or monitoring stations. Camp totals are not people counts. A January 11 Walbran watch-station lead is not automatically a new event.
open_questions: Concurrent public attendance of 50; whether a new camp is a distinct episode; physical ending.

title: 1492 Land Back Lane occupation and blockades
participants_original: March retrospective quotes 20 current campers; about 50 retaking the camp in 2020 is not January attendance
notes: APTN reports the July 19 start and blockades persisting until February 2021, while the camp still stood on March 30. February removal of barricades does not establish the whole occupation's end. Police responses in July and October are not January responses.

continuity.summary: Situation persisted until February; camp still standing March 30.

open_questions: Threshold at start; January attendance; continuous occupation versus recurring blockades; physical ending.

title: Burnaby anti-TMX tree camps predating January
location: Holmes Creek / Lost Creek tree camps, Burnaby, British Columbia
notes: The organizer archive places the original treehouse in September–December 2020 and describes a new Lost Creek camp after a raid. Its exact start is unknown. Relation to January's Stoney Creek action E020 remains unresolved; this is a possible continuation rather than an approved whole-TMX campaign.

start_date.summary: Archive places the original treehouse and camp sequence in 2020; exact new-camp date remains unverified.

open_questions: Exact start and continuity; threshold of 50; original episode rule; distinction from E020.
